comment: Operator registry for MCP servers, stored at the repo root outside the statically served world/ tree. Add one object per server under servers. stdio servers use an argv command array, never a shell string, and inherit only a minimal environment unless inherit_env is true. http servers use a url and require allow_private true for loopback or private-network hosts. Tool policy: allow/blocked are glob patterns, prepare wins over read_only when both match, and anything unmatched is commit. Credentials are env references, never literal secrets. env holds non-secret literal config; env_from maps a child variable to a parent environment variable. headers are literal and must not contain secrets.

rea.name: REA (Reverse Engineer Anything)
rea.description: Local reverse-engineering MCP server for native binaries, managed assemblies, Apple app bundles, archives, firmware, JavaScript bundles, browser pages, Electron targets, Android packages, and recorded crash or process evidence. Start with mcp_read for analysis and inspection; use mcp_call only for commit-tier actions that change state.

github.name: GitHub (official MCP server)
github.description: GitHub's official remote MCP server (api.githubcopilot.com): repo and code search, issue and pull-request read/write, gist, and notification tools. Authenticates with the operator's GITHUB_TOKEN as a bearer credential (an env reference, never a literal). Read tools run in the read tier; anything that mutates a repo goes through the commit gate like every other MCP server.
